title: propertyScanTernary operation
description: Ternary map at one (T, P): sweeps the composition simplex and reports the phase behaviour — the LLE solubility envelope with tie-lines, or a VLE/VLLE audit — from the declared activity model. The map is the model's fingerprint: change the declared model and the envelope moves.

mode.title: Map mode
mode.description: What each simplex point is asked: `lle` (liquid-liquid flash — the clean solubility map) or the audit modes the reference cases use.

grid.title: Grid resolution
grid.description: `{ n <points>; }` — how finely the domain is sampled.

tieStride.title: Tie-line stride
tieStride.description: Draw every Nth tie-line, so the envelope stays readable.

shard.title: Simplex shard
shard.description: Restrict the sweep to a slice of the simplex — for splitting an expensive map across operations.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — where the per-row results are written, relative to the case directory.
